title: fix(auth): validar expiración del token antes de confiar en el claim
body: El middleware de auth leía `payload.sub` sin verificar `exp`. Este PR agrega el chequeo de expiración y un test. Cierra VRTV-123.
author: lapc506

changed_files.patch:
@@ -20,4 +20,18 @@ describe("authMiddleware", () => {
     expect(() => authMiddleware(req)).toThrow("missing token")
   })
+
+  it("rechaza un token expirado", () => {
+    const expired = signJwt({ sub: "u1", exp: 1 })
+    const req = mockRequest({ authorization: `Bearer ${expired}` })
+    expect(() => authMiddleware(req)).toThrow("token expired")
+  })
+
+  it("acepta un token vigente", () => {
+    const future = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600
+    const valid = signJwt({ sub: "u1", exp: future })
+    const req = mockRequest({ authorization: `Bearer ${valid}` })
+    expect(authMiddleware(req).userId).toBe("u1")
+  })
 }
